tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma dang*// rdo rje 'jigs byed la btud nas// de nyid sgrub pa'i rim pa mchog /bdud 'joms snang ba bshad kyis nyon// dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas stan bde ba la kha lho phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pha rgyud spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs te yab kyi sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bdag gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par bsams la/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badz+ra sa twa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/

dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+rī bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa aḥ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod// gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi zhes sogs spyi dang mthun/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong dag pa ltar gyur/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer lnga 'phros pas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag byas par bsam/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra la s+ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ mā le trām̐/ gī tī hrīḥ nṛ t+ye aḥ dhū pe hūm̐/ puṣ+pe trām̐/ dī pe hrīḥ gan+dhe aḥ zhes brjod/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dpal chen po'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ zhes brjod/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs sdom gzung lan gsum brjod/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyogs kun du 'od zer 'phros pas/ sra zhing brtan pa mi phyed cing rgya che ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba 'bar bas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i sa gzhi la/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du/ mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig dang ldan pa/ steng keng rus kyis gur phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang*/ rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i zhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ sprin dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ klu dang bcas shing*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha za dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang bas bskor ba'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang gi shes pa dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can/

de las tshad med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas nas/ slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'jam dbyangs su gyur pa ni/ gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ 'gying ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pa'i phyag gis ut+pa lar gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i pu sti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas bklubs shing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhi ba dang*/ 'dzum pa dang*/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥyig ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa bdag la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ā li dang kā li dang*/ rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po/ rang rang gi sgra 'brug gi dbyangs ltar sgrogs bzhin pa dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas hūm̐ gi yi ge mthing nag chen po zhig tu gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ rdo rje dang*/ gri gug dang*/ thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa shin tu gdengs pa/ lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa cig tu gyur/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs su byas nas slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// khro bor gyur pa gshin rje'i gshed// zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum// g.yon brkyang rnam par 'gying bas bzhugs// rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong*// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrogs// steng zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad// de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal// gser gyi mdog can cung zad khro// g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal// dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs// gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing*// gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can// g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal// dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed// gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed// gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed// zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan// g.yas pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin// gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing dang*// chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa// dgra s+t+wa mdung mda' lcags kyu dang*// dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang*// rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang*// ral gri rde'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin// g.yon pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du// khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*// mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu// rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang*// ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang*// 'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin// tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis// glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon// zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du// mi dang ma he glang bong bu// rnga mo khyi lug ce spyang mnan// g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang*// 'ug pa khwa dang bya rog dang*// ne tso khyung chen ri skeg bzhad// mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis// tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang*// drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams// bsgyel nas kha bub nyid du mnan// mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis// khro zhal rnams kyi dbu la brgyan// mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang*// sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug

/rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan// thal chen mchog gis tshom bu dang*// khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang*// zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan// liṅga dmar po gyen du langs// sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro// sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs// de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ mig byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra ti staṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ thams cad kyis khro bo'i phyag mtshan dang chas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ khyad par du khro bo'i mthu stobs dang phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/

rang gi snying ga nas lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrogs/ dril bu rnams spros pas/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du dgug gzhug bcings mnyes par byas par bsams shing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ de bzhin du/ pā sha hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa baṃ/ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can gyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsams la/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas gnas gsum du gtugs te/ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥ lan re re brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas nang mchod ya mān+ta ka sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi dbus su yaṃ las rlung dang raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a las sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su ya/ shar du k+ṣe/ lhor ma/ nub tu me/ byang du da/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ yi ge lnga dang bcas pa zhu nas spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du chags pa'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas/ byang du don yod grub pa rnams so so'i yum dang bcas pa de rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/

rigs lnga'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ de nyid kyi tshe bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum bcu 'od du zhu nas 'dres pas kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ bcud phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te myangs pas lus thams cad bde bas khyab par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ thugs ka nas sprul ba'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// longs spyod yul du du mar snang*// shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no// 'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la// rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la// dges pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod// reg bya 'gag pa med pa la// mi g.yo bzhin du rol par mdzod// ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

zhes brjod/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i// zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed po ni// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rje sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i// ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa// dud ka mun chen khyod la bstod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim par bsams la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag go /de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo man ngag bzhin gsal btab ste/ sngags las 'od zer 'phros pas phrin las bzhi 'grub cing sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsams la byin gyis brlabs pa'i phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya dā yo ni/ ra yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha/ ni rā ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nye snying rnams ci nus bzla/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni rtsa sngags 'bum phrag bzhi/ snying po 'bum phrag bcu/ nye snying 'bum phrag bdun bzla'o// bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim par bsams la dge ba bsngo'o// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ oṃ

zhes pas snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥ zhes pas grags pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes pas sems kyi 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes su shes par byas la lha la lhas mchod pa/ sgyu ma lta bur blos zin par bya'o// kha zas za ba'i tshe bza' btung oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce snying gar slebs pa'i khrod na bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong rnams bzhugs par dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'o// nyal ba'i tshe phyi'i dngos po thams cad lus la thim/ lus kyang snying ga'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yang mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams la nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis rang dang snang ba thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du shes pa'i sgo nas rnal 'byor gzhan la 'jug par bya'o// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma ci 'byor ba bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs te nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can/ zhes sogs kyis rgyu 'bras lha bskyed pa nas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa'i bar mdun bskyed kyi tshul du bskyed la/ 'khor dang bcas pas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sarba bi gh+nan sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di//

zhes sogs kyis mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyis zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas rnams// zhes sogs kyis mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ nag po chen po sogs la 'bul na skabs 'dir phul/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams rim pas bstan te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa du ma spros pas phyogs skyong ba rnams bkug par bsams la lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo phyogs bcur bskor ba lcags kyu ltar bkug la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ dang*/ in+d+rā duṣ+ṭāṃ sa pa ri wa ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ phyogs skyong rnams mdun du 'khod pa la spyi bo nas phur bus btab pas skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam/ de la phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ in+d+rā ya hrīḥ ya mā ya ṣ+ṭiḥ wa ru ṇā ya wi/ ku we rā ya kṛ/ ī shwa rā ya ta/ ag+na ye ā/ nair ṛ ta ye na/ wā ya we na/ brah+ma ṇā ye hūm̐/ pṛ thi wi bh+yaḥphaṭ/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa lnga'am bdun la sogs pas phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms// dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa// gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing*// phyogs skyong bcu yi tshogs la 'dud// ces pa'i mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ las gshin gyi gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ma he'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las las kyi gshin rje mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/

phyag g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing*/ gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐/ zhes sogs lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba dbyug pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag oṃ kā la rū pa gṛh+ne daṃ/ zhes kun la sbyar ba'i/ oṃ ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā sa mchod/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba bigh+nā na sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lnga la sogs pas phul/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas// srog la rngams pa'i gshin rje ni// nag po ma he'i gdan steng du// ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni// thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba'i// gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdong*// za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khrugs// skra ser sma ra gyen du 'dzings// lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching*// lag g.yas dbyug pas rdul du rlog

/chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs// bran dang bcas pa'i dus la bab// sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi// gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes// rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang*// snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// zungs shig 'chings shig rnam par sdoms// khug cig drongs shig dbang du bsdus// gsod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis// phyes shig non cig rmugs par gyis// thul cig choms shig rnam par shigs// rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis// zhes brjod/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis mgo drangs la/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang*/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus bzlas pas ji ltar bsgo ba khas blangs par bsam mo// 'di ni dpa' bo gcig pa tsam ste lha bcu gsum ma la mos na gtor chog logs su shes par bya'o// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wa ra zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang yid byung gis mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ces sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyi se gol dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa badz+ra muḥ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wa ra gats+tsha/ ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la rang gi gnas gsum dang skye mched drug bsrungs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / ces sogs dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis dus rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na gnas skabs su mi mthun phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// de ltar 'jam dbyangs khro chen gyi// sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba 'di// sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// 'chi bdag dgra las rgyal rgyur cig

/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bdud 'joms snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rong ston byang chub blo gros zhes bya bas rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po rat+na war+dha yab sras rnams kyi bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la gzhi byas/ rje btsun rwa lo tswa ba chen po'i gsung rab la yang gtugs te shin tu dag par spre'u zhes pa me mo lug gi lo snon gyi zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gcig gi nyin/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni byams pa yon tan zhes pas bgyis pa dge'o// 'dis bstan pa rin po che dang sems can du ma la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //'jigs byed dag dran ni/ dam pa'i don du rnam dag pa// dus ni dpa' bo chen po'i gzugs// zhal brgyad thun tshod spyi yin no// phyag dang rwa gnyis zla ba dang*// zla ba phyed dang yang dag sbyor// zhon pa bcu drug dus dang ni// zla ba yi ni zhag tu shes// zhal ni gza' dgu dag tu shes// phyag ni rgyu skar dag dang sbyar// zhabs ni 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang*// dus bzhi yang ni de bzhin no// mtshon cha rnams ni stong pa dang*// snying rje dag ni bcu drug gnyis// glang chen lpags pas bgegs chen ste// drag po'i gzugs ni sdug bsngal che// sel bar byed pa'i gtso bo 'o// kha dog nag po byams pa che// thod pa'i rgyan ni mi 'gyur ba'o// dkyil 'khor lha ni thams cad dag /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dus dag go /sngags gsum dag pa sku gsum mo// lha rnams nyid kyi rang ming ni// dang po oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa mtha'o// thod pa btung ba'i dus dag go /dkyil 'khor byang chub phyogs yin no// zhon pa pa ri pin ti nyid// mdog sogs de bzhin gshegs pa ste// dag pa thams cad shes pa 'o//

de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang 'jigs byed du bsgoms pa'i snying gar 'di snying ga'i thugs rdo rje yin/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa gur thabs/ de'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad de gnyis kyi lte ba sprad cing*/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad po rtsibs kyi nang du song*/ lte bar hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar nye snying dang*/ de'i mthar snying po gnyis g.yas bskor/ 'dab ma'i steng gi bar snang la/ shar du ya ma rā dza/ mer sa do me ya/ lhor ya me do ru/ srin por ṇa yo da ya/ nub tu ya dwa yo ni/ rlung du ra yak+ṣe ya/ byang du yak+ṣe ya ts+tsha/ dbang ldan du ni rā ma ya rnams lang stabs su yod pa'i steng du oṃ dang*/ 'og tu hūm̐ phaṭa rnams kha dog sngon po/ de rnams las las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas phrin las bzhi 'grub cing*/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsams la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phreng ba la rdo rjes nang mchod gtor te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du phreng rdog re re nas skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa gri thod 'dzin pa'i skur gyur par bsams la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ ci rigs bzlas te phreng ba la has btab la bzlas pa bya// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
